title: [Chapitre] VIII. Analysis situs (quatrième mouture) : notes manuscrites (26/06-04/07/1986).

errors: The final equivalence must read 'atoms(X)° ∩ atoms(Y)° = ∅' if the relation is disjointness of interiors (|o|), consistent with p. 33 (iii); the machine transcription's '≠ ∅' is likely a misreading or slip.

The implication X |o| Y => phi(X) |o| phi(Y) tacitly needs that X |o| Y forces disjoint atom-interiors in the source. This hypothesis is not stated on the page (presumably part of the 'génériques' assumption crossed out/partly illegible).

ideas.what: Abstract structure of regions with part-of, interior-part and non-overlap relations (magasins) and morphisms preserving them
ideas.modern_name: Mereotopology / contact algebras (part-of, non-tangential proper part, external contact), also face posets of regular CW complexes
ideas.usually_credited_to: Whitehead, de Laguna (1920s); Clarke (1981); Randell–Cui–Cohn RCC (1992); Dimov–Vakarelov contact algebras (2000s)
ideas.where_published: Only the motivation ('topologie modérée') appears in Esquisse d'un programme (1984); magasin axiomatics unpublished

ideas.what: Map from figures to sets of molecules preserving disjointness of interiors, under nonempty-interior hypothesis
ideas.modern_name: Morphism to the set-theoretic (cellular) model; cellular realization

ideas.what: Surjection of sets induces injective morphism of set-theoretic magasins by preimage

missed.claim: Grothendieck's 1986 magasin axiomatics for tame topology, with support/representation functions into point sets on the next page, is essentially an independent development of point-free mereotopology and contact algebras with their Stone-type representation theorems. This link between his 'topologie modérée' program and the mereotopology / qualitative-spatial-reasoning literature has not been made in the literature as far as I know.
missed.quote: X |o| Y ⟹ molécules(X) |o| molécules Y ... la notion de [application] combinatoire proposée à la p. 27, n'est pas trop idiote
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: It could connect o-minimal / tame-topology foundations with region-based topology (RCC, contact algebras) and their representation theory. It would also give a historically independent source for morphisms of region structures.

deep.surprise_reason: The page itself is routine examples checking a morphism notion. The surrounding unpublished axiomatics anticipating mereotopology-style structures in a tame-topology setting is of some historical interest but not striking on this page alone.
transcription_corrections: The relation symbol written '|·|' is almost certainly '|o|' (small circle: disjoint interiors), matching p. 33.
The final condition likely reads 'atomes(X)° ∩ atomes(Y)° = ∅', not '≠ ∅'.
'notion de combinatoire' is probably 'notion d'application combinatoire'; 'régions ensemblistes' is likely 'magasins ensemblistes'.
'Fig[-él-](L)' is likely 'Figél(L)' or 'Figel', i.e. elementary figures; 'Figl(E)' in Example 3 is likely the same Fig notation for set-theoretic figures.
